description: Ground truth for printed-map-photo.jpg: a phone photo (1932x2576) of the printed Grootkloof sheet on a wooden table, folded in four (creases near x=938 and y=1278), so no single homography fits it. Photo pixels, top-left origin. control_points map photo pixels to lat/lon (and map.jpg pixels) through a dense SIFT field; see make_truth.py. homography_floor_m is the error of the best single homography over the control points, the floor for any flat model.
